scope: Independent stdlib source-hash, declared-prior reconstruction, chronology, probability and EV audit. Player outcome fields were inspected only for frozen listed prior player-games plus the 2023–24 league baseline; goalie fields were inspected only for frozen listed opponent/rejected prior team-games plus that league baseline. No forecast-target settlement or scoring calculation.
limits: Validates all exported prior IDs and their aggregates; does not independently reconstruct excluded price-cohort attrition or prove that no eligible history was omitted from each last-80 / last-40 window. Earlier candidate results are permitted only as frozen prior-history inputs for later forecasts.
